verdict.rationale: Qodo documents an official Agentic Toolbox CLI that can 'review changes before opening a pull request' and runs Qodo-managed skills locally. However, it is framed as supplying skills to a coding agent rather than as a standalone review command, so only the local-diff part of the story is covered, and thinly. Missing for 10: documented use in CI scripts or headless pipelines, machine-readable output (e.g. JSON/SARIF) for tooling, explicit standalone CLI review invocation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI review.
